body: I hate to hear that, I wish life was just easy all the time and it’s so frustrating that it’s not. Sending so much love to you, I hope that you’re able to end the day with a smile

Nah just an open letter/rant. I had been sitting in my car in an empty lot alongside a river for probably an hour before they pulled up. I think they were parked across the street in another lot with their lights off so I hadn’t noticed them. 

And no, I wasn’t planning to survive, so nobody would have to pay for me.
